Vets RISE Program - SkillBridge Training Outline

Course Participant: Priya N. Raghavan
Training Outline Title: Cloud Operations & Quality Track
Duration: 16 weeks
Location: Hybrid - Fort Brandon Learning Annex
Hours: 640

Week 11 (Nov 17 - Nov 21): Cloud Fundamentals (40 hours)
Objective: Describe core cloud service and deployment models.
Day 1: AWS Cloud Practitioner essentials; Shared responsibility model
Day 2: Compute and storage services tour; S3 basics
Day 3: Networking in the cloud; VPC concepts
Day 4: Identity and access management; Least-privilege design
Day 5: Cloud cost awareness; Billing dashboards

Week 12 (Nov 24 - Nov 26): Applied Cloud Lab (24 hours)
Objective: Deploy a small workload end to end.
Day 1: Lab setup; Deploying a static site
Day 2: Monitoring and alarms; CloudWatch basics
Day 3: Lab review and cleanup
No class Thursday or Friday - Thanksgiving Holiday.

Week 15 (Dec 29 - Jan 2): Quality Systems (32 hours)
Objective: Connect quality frameworks to day-to-day operations work.
Day 1: Green Belt Foundations refresher; Quality gates
Day 2: ISO 9001 overview; Audit readiness
Day 3: Incident postmortems; Blameless review practice
Day 4: Course wrap-up; Capstone presentations
No class Thursday - New Year's Day Holiday.
* Guest speaker: quality director from a regional utility (name varies by cohort).
